findings.source: host.py main.stop() and terminal failure/normal paths
findings.problem: Observer leader liveness is treated as process-group liveness. Already-reaped leader skips all signals; prompt leader TERM exit skips KILL even if descendants survive. Deadline/failure can leave pytest descendants alive beyond supervised bound.
findings.minimal_correction: Own and clean the entire started process group independently of leader.poll/wait result. Bound TERM grace and group KILL/reaping/verification; tolerate already-empty group. Apply on timeout/signal/failed observer and prevent terminal promotion with surviving children.
regressions: reaped leader with still-live grandchild gets group termination
leader exits on TERM while grandchild ignores TERM -> bounded KILL escalation
